summary: Tested AI Feature 3: Daily Briefing end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 tests passing (auth, probe, generate+cache, delete+cache, content/persistence, regression). Frontend: all 4 briefing states verified (State 1: Generate button + hint text, State 2: spinner 'Claude is reviewing your pipeline…', State 3: 4 parsed sections with teal labels, State 4: cache loads instantly on re-navigation). Regenerate flow working. All dashboard sections intact. AI Feature 1 (Borrower Strength Score 85/100) and AI Feature 2 (Lender Match 3 results) regressions confirmed passing.

issues: Direct URL navigation (browser reload on /dashboard) triggers onboarding wizard — existing known behaviour, not caused by this feature. Must navigate via sidebar links.

critical_code_review_comments: Test file test_ai_daily_briefing.py was updated to correctly unwrap {success, data, message} envelope from all API responses (old tests compared r.json() directly to unwrapped payload causing failures). Updated to use r.json()['data'] for all data assertions.
All 4 briefing section labels (SUMMARY, TODAY'S PRIORITIES, WATCH LIST, CLOSING NOTE) confirmed present in Claude's output and correctly parsed by parseBriefingSections() in Dashboard.js.
DELETE /api/ai/daily-briefing returns exactly {success:true, data:{cleared:true}, message:null} — verified both via backend test and browser fetch.
probe=true fast path confirmed sub-150ms (no Claude call) when cache is empty.
Briefing caching is working correctly — second GET within same day returns cached:true with identical content and fast response (<150ms).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing data: James Wilson case (AIP Received, TEST_Lender_X, £350,000)
